Strider.name: Strider
Strider.summary: The Striders are a global organization of infiltration specialists who work to combat villainy and keep the world safe. From their orbital space station, the Blue Dragon, they are able to quickly reach anywhere in the world.

Super Bros. 6.name: Super Mario Bros. 6
Super Bros. 6.summary:
Inspired by the old unlicensed NES title “Super Bros 6″ (which was actually Tiny Toon Adventures), this hack makes aesthetic changes such as:

- All enemies were replaced by enemies from the Super Mario universe
- All bosses now belong to the Mario universe (including the Secret boss)
- Some level design adjustments were made in several levels to make better use of resources.
- Some levels were totally changed to fit the theme of the game
- Cinematics tell a totally new story along with other minor changes

Super Pinball.name: Super Pinball
Super Pinball.summary:
At the beginning of the game the player is given an incomplete mahjong hand with one missing tile. They are then shown the tile that will complete their hand and locating that tile is the goal of the pinball game. When the tile is found the game ends immediately. The players now completed hand will determine their final score as their score from pinball will be multiplied by the strength of their hand.

It features racing and sci-fi themed tables among others.
